To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the RNA extraction method based on the use of Qiagen RNease Mini kit coupled with one‐ step reverse transcriptase PCR (RT‐ PCR) proved to be a reliable, simple, and safe tool for rapid, sensitive, and specific detection of both types of vesicular stomatosis virus (VSV‐IND and ‐NJ) in cell lysate as well as in spiked tissue samples.

a new RNA extraction method coupled with multiplex RT‐PCT assay can be used for the rapid detection and differentiation of both types of vesicular stomatis virus in cell lysates as well as in spiked tissue samples with high sensitivity.
we have improved the detection limit of a multiplex RT‐PCRa for the simultaneous detection of vesicular stomatis virus (VSV)-IND and VSV-NJ to as low as 1 fg of viral RNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the detection of vesicular stomitis virus (VSV), which is the causative agent of vesicular stomatis, a contagious and highly infectious disease of cattle and horses, which has been reported in the United States.
the development of a simple and sensitive method for the detection of VSV.

the development and evaluation of a new, simple, and reliable method for the detection and differential diagnosis of vesicular stomitis virus Indiana1 (VSV‐IND) and New Jersey (VSV‐NJ) in cell culture and in bovine lymph node tissue samples by using a one‐step RT PCR assay.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present study improved significantly the sensitivity of previously published multiplex RT‐PCRs for the detection and differential diagnosis of VSV‐Indiana and VSV‐New Jersey strains.

the RNA extraction method using the Qiagen RNeasY Mini Kit followed by one‐step RT–PCR is a simple, safe and practicable, and highly sensitive and specific tool for the rapid, simultaneous, and differential detection of VSV‐NJ and VSV‐IND in cell lysate as well as spiked tissue samples.

the Qiagen RNease Mini Kit is a simple, safe and practicable, and highly sensitive and reliable tool for the rapid, differential diagnosis of VSV‐NJ and VSV‐IND in a single reaction tube, as compared with the Tri‐reagent method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this is the first study to report the use of Qiagen RNeasay Mini Kit for the extraction and amplification of RNA of VSV.
the RNA extraction method using the Qiagen kit followed by multiplex RT‐ PCR is an efficient, reliable, and highly sensitive tool to detect VSV‐IND or NJ from cell culture or tissue samples.
the RNA extraction method used in this work is more effective than the tri‐phased RNA extraction method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed and validated a simple, safe and highly sensitive method for the detection and discrimination of vesicular stomitis virus (VSV).
the RNA extraction method is critical to achieve the desired sensitivity.
the Qiagen RNA extraction method is more effective than the Tri‐reagent method for the extraction and detection of VSV‐RNA in tissue samples and cell culture.
